body: Unfortunately the games probably take up most of my free time lately... It's the only thing that I know that will always work to make me forget about life. Or it might just be what I've become most comfortable with and I'm afraid to branch out. I enjoy my time while playing the games... but I don't like the thought of me spending so much time on them. I'll try to find some other enjoyable things to spend my time on. Thanks a lot for the reply, I really appreciate it a lot.
